description: Closed vocabulary of every motion pattern actually present on the site. A PageSpec node can only choose from the patterns its section contract lists. There are NO scroll-triggered fade-ups, parallax or scroll-linked transforms on the site; the single scroll reveal is scroll-reveal-two-way on the PageLinks cards. Where CLONE_SPEC.md or PAGES_SPEC.md disagree with src/motion.js or the implemented components, the implemented QA-verified value is recorded here (see extraction/measured-values.json corrections).

reducedMotionFallbacks.transition-removed: Transitions on the listed properties are set to none; state changes become instant.
reducedMotionFallbacks.transition-unchanged: Not gated: the transition still runs under prefers-reduced-motion (matches the original, which animates it either way).
reducedMotionFallbacks.animation-stopped: The CSS or script animation is removed and the element rests in its static state.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-first-frame: The cycler or loop is disabled and the first state (first message, first prompt, full text, first slide) is shown statically. Manual controls, where they exist, still switch state without animation.
reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-swap: The view change happens without motion (no slide, scale or height animation).
reducedMotionFallbacks.autoplay-continues-transitions-removed: The autoplay timer is NOT stopped; only the visual cross-fades and resize transitions are removed.
reducedMotionFallbacks.autoplay-continues-unchanged: The autoplay is NOT stopped and is not gated on prefers-reduced-motion at all (matches the original).
reducedMotionFallbacks.opacity-only-crossfade: Transform effects (translate, rotate) are dropped; an opacity cross-fade remains.
reducedMotionFallbacks.autoplay-disabled-controls-hidden: Autoplay is disabled and the play/pause control is not rendered; slides change only on user input, without transitions.
